text: SK Hynix surpassed a $1 trillion market capitalization amid continued demand for AI memory infrastructure. SK Hynix and Samsung Electronics accounted for more than 40% of the Kospi index as semiconductor-linked capital concentration intensified. South Korean equity performance remained structurally coupled to global AI server, accelerator, and memory demand conditions.

meta.note: Volatility exists as a latent condition within concentrated index exposure.
